shared.title: How bridges stand up
shared.gist: Ada and Ben load a pine bridge until it breaks, then show why an arch carries more.
shared.sections:
1. [0:00] Loading a bridge until it breaks: Ada and Ben load a pine bridge, ton by ton.
2. [2:40] The bridge itself: Ada built it from pine, and says why.
